scenes.title: Level 11: Lead guitar
scenes.subtitle: Scales, licks and bends
lines: Learn the minor pentatonic scale, craft your first licks, and bend notes to make them sing.
This is where your solos come to life.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll play minor pentatonic scales, create short melodic licks and bend notes to add emotion to your solos.
You'll have the tools to improvise confidently in rock, blues and modern styles.
Let's start with the minor pentatonic scale — the foundation of rock and blues solos.
